title: A Caracal Jumps 10 Feet Straight Up to Snatch Birds

scenes.text: This cat can out-jump a bird. While it's still flying.
The caracal leaps about three meters straight up. That's roughly ten feet.
It waits where doves and sandgrouse gather at water holes in the dry season.
Then it explodes upward and snatches the bird out of the air with hooked claws.
Sometimes it knocks down two birds at a time.
Ten feet up, in one jump. For a bird, the sky isn't safe.

description:

Could any bird escape a jump like that? Tell us below.
first_comment: Caracals are famous for those tufted ears. Would you rather face a caracal or a serval? Tell us why.
